description: After fz-bin.12 raises the fz2 frontdoor drive budget enough for fixtures2/behavior/enum_take_drop_split.fz to pass semantic closure, the fixture exposes downstream execution failures. fz2 interp prints four [] lines then exits with 'backend value 0 is unbound'. fz2 run reaches native codegen and panics at src/compiler2/native_codegen/fn_ctx.rs:827: index out of bounds: len is 2 but index is 2. fz2 build reaches the same native codegen panic after the warning. Investigate backend/native execution for Enum take/drop/split before re-enabling the fixture.

comments.text: Partial progress before blocker fz-dh8: fz2 interp for fixtures2/behavior/enum_take_drop_split.fz now prints the full expected stdout in local testing. The fixture cannot be re-enabled for run/build yet because native JIT/AOT still produce incorrect tuple-accumulator list tails; fz-dh8 tracks that prerequisite and blocks this ticket.

title: Enum take/drop/split execution fails after compiler drive completes
